summary.note: 2026-08-26 fixer pass: all 38 pending blocks indexed + screenshotted (2 renamed to resolve id collisions: dashboard/empty-state-panel-01, stats/stats-strip-01). Navbar actions orphaning fixed for the last 3 navbars; ToggleGroup children, string breadcrumbs, data-URI images, and Badge "check" text converted to renderer-supported forms. Remaining flags: feature layout subjectives + full-page categorization (sidebar-layout-01, app-shell-01, changelog-page-01 verbosity).

fixes_applied.description: Converted 170 blocks from flat property format to props wrapper format.
Fixed 24 elements in 18 blocks where duplicate JSON 'type' key caused Input components to be parsed incorrectly.
Updated List renderer to accept plain string items.
Updated Field renderer to render child elements (Input) instead of creating internal input.
Replaced Carousel children pattern with Card+Grid for 5 blocks. Carousel renderer only supports props.slides, not children.
Changed Tabs from props.items to props.tabs with {id,label} format + children array for 3 blocks.
Restructured navbars from Navbar type to explicit Stack+Surface+Link layout to fix orphaned actions rendering.
Replaced invisible Modal/overlay types with Card equivalents for screenshot-friendly rendering.
Removed AspectRatio wrappers and added explicit height on Image elements.

Indexed 38 missing blocks with curated metadata + thumbs; restructured navbar-mega-menu-01/navbar-with-auth-01/navbar-mobile-drawer-01 away from unsupported Navbar props.actions refs (0 orphan elements library-wide); converted ToggleGroup children to props.options (product-card-01, product-detail-01); product-detail-01 now Grid 2-col with object breadcrumbs and single-seed gallery; replaced 26 data-URI images with seeded picsum (isSafeUrl blocks data:); Badge text "check" now a real checkmark glyph (hero-split-01, cta-screen-mockup-04, cta-split-image-quote-01); chart-section-01 ChartCards given Chart children with bars; command-palette-01 List items use title/secondary; feature-bento-01 uses Grid spans (2/3) for a true bento; navbar-mobile-drawer-01 Sheet uses position prop.

systemic_issues.description: Carousel renderer only supports props.slides (text strings), not children elements. Workaround: use Card+Grid layout.
Tabs renderer uses props.tabs [{id,label}] not props.items. 3 blocks corrected.
Navbar actions prop referencing element IDs causes orphaned rendering. Fixed by using explicit layout (all 5 navbar blocks restructured; props.actions convention no longer used anywhere).

Modal/Sheet/Drawer/CommandPalette are force-opened and BottomNav pinned static+always by tools/block-screenshot.js during capture; bottom-nav-01, command-palette-01, lightbox-01, modal-confirm-01 thumbs regenerated.
ChartCard renderer ignores props.data; blocks now provide a Chart child with bars (chart-section-01). Other chart thumbs still render empty until given Chart children.
